lines.t: (Intro build up)
(Verse 1)
Morning breaks on a restless heart
Dust on my feet, I wandered far
Chasing shadows, chasing sound
Looking for truth I never found
(Pre-Chorus)
Then Your voice came soft and near
Living water calmed my fear
Not with force, not with flame
Just quiet love that called my name
(Chorus)
YahuShua, You waited for me
By the river of mercy flowing free
YahuShua, You opened my eyes
To a love that never fades or dies
(Verse 2)
I held on to what would not last
Built my hope on a fragile past
Every promise turned to sand
Slipped right through my open hands
(Pre-Chorus)
Still You stood where I could fall
Grace unearned, You gave it all
You didn’t turn, You didn’t leave
You stayed right there and I believed
(Chorus)
YahuShua, You waited for me
By the river of mercy flowing free
YahuShua, You opened my eyes
To a love that never fades or dies
(Bridge)
Your truth moves steady, slow and strong
A guiding light when I was wrong
Not bound by time, not moved by fear
Your kingdom’s closer than it appears
(Chorus)
YahuShua, You waited for me
By the river of mercy flowing free
YahuShua, You opened my eyes
To a love that never fades or dies
(Outro)
From the rising sun to evening’s end
I’ll walk with You, my Savior, Friend
Every breath, every day
I live in truth, I walk Your way
